projects.title: UVS Games
projects.summary: A redesign of UVS Games — home of the UniVersus card game — with a new navigation, homepage and organized-play experience.

content.p: UVS publishes several games — UniVersus, Riftbound and Star Trek: Star Realms — but the old site hid them behind a long text menu, and the homepage was a single banner followed by a newsletter form. Players had no clear path to events, card lists or stores.
Games, Discover and Hub are grouped in one mega menu, with live artwork for the game you hover.

video.caption: Mobile navigation — collapsible groups and a persistent shop button

sections.heading: A homepage that does the work

ul: Every game gets its own card with "Explore game" and "Find a store"
Latest news and upcoming events sit right on the homepage
Organized play for each game has its own banner and CTA

projects.title: Aeon Health & Shop
projects.summary: A new website for a Calgary longevity clinic, with a guided 'Start here' flow — plus an online shop for its supplements.

compare.caption: Second section — from mission statement to the patient's story

content.p: The old site listed every program in one long dropdown and didn't give new visitors an obvious first step. The redesign leads with how people feel, then guides them to one.
"Start here" lets visitors book a free consult straight away, or take a 5-question quiz that recommends a program.
Programs and therapies are grouped by what the patient wants — feel better, prevent, recharge — instead of by clinic jargon.
A companion store for Aeon's supplements: collections by need, quick-add flavours, and subscribe-and-save on every product page.

projects.title: Agentic AI Foundation
projects.summary: The website for the Agentic AI Foundation — the Linux Foundation home of MCP, goose and AGENTS.md — rebuilt around projects, events and community.

compare.caption: aaif.io on mobile — the December 2025 launch site vs. the live redesign

content.p: The launch site introduced the foundation. The redesign turns it into a hub people come back to — for projects, events and community.
A filterable directory of agentic AI projects, grouped by application and capability.
Foundation events, community events and groups — browsable as a grid, a calendar or a map.
The hero search opens a chatbot for questions like "Any upcoming events in Toronto?"

projects.title: Oxy Acne Care
projects.summary: A new store for Oxy Acne Care — a bold, Gen-Z rebrand built around "For every kind of -ne".

content.p: The old Oxy site was a straightforward product catalogue. The relaunch needed a voice as bold as the new brand — and an easier way to shop by acne type.
The hero splits into Mild, Stubborn and All Acne — each panel opens its own message and products. The mega menus follow the same shop-by-concern logic.

projects.title: Loop Tag
projects.summary: Brand site and app for Loop Tag — QR tags that let anyone return a lost item without either person sharing personal details.

compare.caption: From a pre-launch waitlist page to the live store

content.p: Attach a tag, someone scans it, and you chat privately — no phone number, email or address shared. The site and app both had to make that promise obvious in seconds.
Two flows: owners activate and manage tags; finders scan and message without signing up.
